content.short: Cross-chain bridge promising low fees, low slippage and small minimums for moving assets.
content.description: Firefly Labs describes itself as a universal asset interoperability protocol: a bridge for moving tokens such as USDC between chains in one step. It focuses on cheap transfers with low slippage and low minimum amounts, and offers an API and SDK so other apps can embed its routes. It supports Unichain, World Chain and Stable among its networks.
content.meta: Bridge assets like USDC between chains with Firefly Labs, built for low fees, low slippage and small minimums.
